title: Bantu: branches, not a column
hook: Can one arrow capture thousands of years of movement?

knows: Events happen in places and at different times.

objective: The branches represent many small movements and exchanges over millennia.

claims.text: 3000–2000 BCE: Origins. Expansion begins near Nigeria and Cameroon.
claims.source: https://openstax.org/books/world-history-volume-1/pages/9-2-the-emergence-of-farming-and-the-bantu-migrations — The Bantu migrations: language, debated chronology and eastern/western streams

claims.text: c. 1500 BCE: Two streams. Movements branch toward coasts and eastern lakes.
claims.source: https://openstax.org/books/world-history-volume-1/pages/9-2-the-emergence-of-farming-and-the-bantu-migrations — The Bantu migrations: language, debated chronology and eastern/western streams

claims.text: Early CE: Further branches. Communities spread into southern regions.
claims.source: https://openstax.org/books/world-history-volume-1/pages/9-2-the-emergence-of-farming-and-the-bantu-migrations — The Bantu migrations: language, debated chronology and eastern/western streams

claims.text: By 700 CE: Many communities. Bantu-speaking communities span much of eastern and southern Africa.
claims.source: https://openstax.org/books/world-history-volume-1/pages/9-2-the-emergence-of-farming-and-the-bantu-migrations — The Bantu migrations: language, debated chronology and eastern/western streams

claims.text: The branches represent many small movements and exchanges over millennia. “Bantu” refers to related languages, not a single army or a uniform people. Linguistic and archaeological evidence supports broad patterns, while the timing, motives and exact directions remain debated.
claims.source: https://openstax.org/books/world-history-volume-1/pages/9-2-the-emergence-of-farming-and-the-bantu-migrations — The Bantu migrations: language, debated chronology and eastern/western streams

claims.text: Broad regional summaries, not individual journeys or empty-land claims.
